Home.eyebrow: Income tax, NTN, and sales tax
Home.title: File your tax return in minutes, not days.
Home.sub: A calmer way for people and small businesses in Pakistan to prepare a return, register an NTN, and see the tax on a salary.
Home.howSub: Four steps from a new account to a filed return.
Home.accountBody: Start with a mobile number. Email is the backup.
Home.incomeBody: Salary, business, rent, and other sources in plain language.
Home.reviewBody: Check the numbers before anything is sent.
Home.filedBody: Keep the receipt with the return.
Home.whySub: The work stays understandable, and government charges stay separate from the service fee.
Home.fbrCardBody: Returns, NTN, and sales tax follow the path a filer actually needs.
Home.expertsBody: Priority and Premium include a human look before filing.
Home.secureBody: Your documents stay on your account.
Home.supportBody: Call, email, or WhatsApp. The numbers are in the footer.
Home.fastBody: The form asks for the next fact, not a pile of jargon.
Home.refundsCardBody: When a refund is part of the return, its status stays on the file.
Home.pricingSub: These prices are samples so the layout can be reviewed. They are not a quote.
Home.calcSub: Move the salary. The tax uses the Tax Year 2027 salaried slabs.
Home.calcChart: Share of annual salary that is tax
Home.appTitle: The same file, on a phone
Home.app1: See the return status without opening a laptop.
Home.app2: Upload a document from the camera roll.
Home.app3: The store listing is not live yet.
Home.aQuote: Sample review. I could see the salary tax before I booked anyone. The form used ordinary words, and the receipt stayed with the file after it was submitted.
Home.bQuote: Sample review. NTN was the part I kept postponing. The steps were short, and the government fee was written apart from the service fee.
Home.cQuote: Sample review. I compared two salaries in the calculator, then asked a person to look at the return. Nothing on this card is a real customer quote.
Home.fileA: Individuals and small businesses preparing an income tax return, an NTN, or a sales tax matter.
Home.ntnA: It is the national tax number FBR uses to identify a filer. Registration is a separate service from the annual return.
Home.feeA: No. A service fee and a government charge are quoted apart.
Home.estimateQ: Is the calculator my filed return?
Home.estimateA: No. It is a salary estimate from published slabs. It is not tax advice and it is not a filed return.
Home.deadlineNote: The date is 30 September 2027 in this preview. Confirm the live FBR deadline before you rely on the count.
